answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The onyx multiplier is published, charged in mirror, and summit lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 3927 identities would post 763 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
